summary: Manulife Financial Corporation filed a Form 6-K announcing the results of conversion privileges for its Class 1 Preferred Shares, Series 3 and Series 4. Holders elected to convert 17,750 Series 3 shares into Series 4 and 886,331 Series 4 shares into Series 3. Because fewer than 1,000,000 Series 4 shares would remain, Manulife automatically converted all remaining Series 4 shares into Series 3 on a one-for-one basis. Post-conversion, 8,000,000 Series 3 shares will be outstanding with a fixed dividend rate of 4.64% for the five-year period starting June 20, 2026. No special situation; routine preferred share conversion.
